name: Charlie
bio: Archetype: ST DPT, AoE DPT, Dispel. ⌽ High, consistent ST damage with lenient skill requirements for bonus DMG. ⌽ Ultimate becomes an AoE nuke at higher Portrait levels. ⌽ The only 5✦ carry that actually slays. ⌽ Insight 3 passive overwrites existing buffs; synergy with non-DMG-Bonus buffers (Baby Blue, Shamane, etc.) ⌽ Very low base Crit Rate; must invest heavily for Crit-oriented play.
